title: feat(scripts): read one changeset against itself, and date the contradiction
body:
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectui#9841

A `.changeset/*.md` that declares a package in its front matter while its own body says that package did not move contradicts itself, and both halves publish verbatim into that package's CHANGELOG. The four structural changeset gates all judge the front matter; the two readings already in `check-changeset-claims.mjs` judge a body against a diff. Nobody read the two halves of one file against each other.

## The falsification pass ran FIRST, and it corrects the card

The card made this the first deliverable and said outright that its filer had not run it. It is run here, both halves, each with a positive control taken before its zeros were believed.

**Pending corpus** — every `.changeset/*.md` in this tree: **1,686 files read, 1,153 of them publishing a body** (the rest declare no bump and reach no CHANGELOG).

**Released corpus** — every `CHANGELOG.md` with a `package.json` beside it: **42 files, 3,279 released version sections, 24,557 entries, versions 0.0.1 through 17.6.0**. 883 of those entries carry a negation-of-change word.

| coordinate | pending | released |
|---|---|---|
| the card's, as written — a sentence naming a declared package and carrying a negation of change | 11 pairings / 10 bodies | 8 |
| the same, also accepting the bare short name (`types`, `layout`) | 23 pairings / 21 bodies | — |
| **attached** — the negation directly on a bare package spelling, nothing between but a copula | **0** | **0** |

⭐ **Every one of those 19 pairings at the card's coordinate is LEGITIMATE.** Read one at a time, they all negate an ASPECT of the package and never the package: «`@object-ui/fields` re-exports all four names unchanged», «Both are internal to `@object-ui/app-shell`; no package export moves», «`packages/app-shell` type-checks unchanged», «`@object-ui/console`'s `/` resolver is unchanged». ⇒ **the card's step 2 as written is the noise its own falsification test was looking for, and it is not built here.** Requiring the negation to ATTACH to the package drops all 19 and keeps the attested instance.

**Positive controls, both corpora.** Planting the carded instance verbatim moves every counter: pending 1,686 → 1,687, publishing 1,153 → 1,154, card's coordinate 11 → 12, attached **0 → 1** and it names the clause. Injecting the same clause as one released entry moves the released side 24,557 → 24,558 and attached **0 → 1**. Both plants were removed and `git diff HEAD` verified empty.

⚠️ **The measurement caveat, stated because it cuts against the artifact.** Both corpora are the SURVIVING state. A contradiction repaired on a branch before merge is in neither — which is exactly what happened to the one attested instance. So these zeros are strong evidence about the FALSE-POSITIVE rate (the thing that decides the check's cost) and weak evidence about the incidence rate. **The case for closing this card instead is real and the numbers above are what it rests on: the shape has landed zero times in 26,243 bodies.** That call is the PM's, not this seat's.

## What landed

A third reading in the same script, in the same report-only, exit-0 posture. ⛔ No new gate, ⛔ no new npm script, ⛔ no new CI context, so no command-parity doc edit.

- **Corpus** — the `.changeset/*.md` this change adds or modifies, read out of this tree.
- **Coordinate** — a package the file's own front matter declares, negated in its own body with nothing between the spelling and the negation but a copula. Either spelling: the npm name, or the workspace directory. The carded instance wrote `packages/types`, never `@object-ui/types`, so a reading that knew only npm names would have been silent on the one artefact it exists for.
- **`--census`** re-derives both coordinates over whatever corpus the tree carries, so no number above is written down anywhere (AGENTS.md #9).

### BORN FALSE vs WENT FALSE, dated from the branch's own revisions

⛔ It cannot be read off the head, and this is measured on the artefact rather than assumed:

- at `2bc8fd12e2`, the commit that ADDED the carded changeset, the body already said «`packages/types` is untouched» and the front matter declared `@object-ui/components` **and nothing else** — the sentence was **true**;
- at `21896172a9`, the same commit that moved **62 lines** in `packages/types/src/overlay.ts` (+35 −27, verified on that commit) added `'@object-ui/types': patch` to that same front matter.

Against the merge base the net diff shows the file simply ADDED with both halves present, which reads as born false. It was not. So the verdict is dated from the revisions of that file, and a range carrying none of them is reported **UNDATED**, ⛔ never defaulted to either verdict.

⚠️ **The BASE revision is read first, and a branch walk alone is not enough** — found and fixed in this PR's second commit, after the first had shipped the defect. A changeset can sit pending for weeks carrying a true sentence and be falsified by a later change adding ONE line to its front matter; that is the shape `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` calls its case 2, so this repository already expects to see it. Walking only `base..head` finds the single commit that added that line, sees the declaration in it, and reports BORN FALSE — accusing an author of writing something untrue weeks before the branch making it existed, which is the exact misreading this card forbids, on the case where the sentence most obviously stood on its own. If the claim is already standing at the base, the base's own front matter decides; the branch walk is reached only for a claim this change itself brought.

### The two mandated defences

**Two distinct floors (objectui#9744).** A `0` from a reader that read nothing and a `0` from a clean corpus are the same character. Floor one: this change adds and modifies no changeset. Floor two, one level in: a corpus was read but every body declares no bump, so there is no front matter for a body to contradict. Neither prints what the other prints, neither prints the clean tick, and each is pinned with `not.toContain` against the other two.

**Hermeticity is structural, not conventional.** This reading takes NO ambient input: no `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`, no pull request body, no environment. Its corpus is `git diff --name-only` under the root it was given. The pin runs the same fixture twice — once clean, once with `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` pointing at a payload whose body is the carded contradiction verbatim — and asserts the section is byte-identical, plus asserts the variable WAS live for that run (the born-false reading above it does read it and its report moves), so the comparison cannot be vacuous.

## Acceptance notes

- **The delivery seam is CLOSED, under an explicit surface extension.** The first round stopped at the file-surface boundary and reported that `changeset-presence.yml` decided comment creation from `findings.length + bornFalse.length`, so a self-contradiction-only finding rendered its comment and was never posted. The seat extended the declared surface to that one file and the third commit adds one term to that one sum — ⛔ no new step, job, permission or context, and the command-parity doc pin is untouched because nothing here adds a command. The declared surface for this work is now `scripts/`, `scripts/__tests__/`, `.changeset/` and `.github/workflows/changeset-presence.yml`, and nothing outside it was touched.

  The new expression, verbatim:

  ```js
  findings =
    measured.findings.length +
    (measured.bornFalse ?? []).length +
    (measured.selfContradiction ?? []).length;
  ```

  ⭐ The pin asserts **the new term on its own**, ⛔ never the sum verbatim. A pin matching the whole sum reddens on a harmless rewording, and it gets repaired by pasting whatever the file now says — which is how a dropped term gets blessed. A third case walks all three terms, so the next reading's author is told, where they will be standing, that a reading without a term here reaches nobody.
- **The known false positive, documented instead of carved out**: a body that declares a package to carry a DEPENDENT bump and says so — «`@object-ui/react` is unchanged; it bumps because core's types moved». That sentence pairs, and it is honest. It occurs zero times in the corpus `--census` reads, and a carve-out for a shape nobody writes is a hole nobody is watching.
- **The first commit shipped a dating defect and the second fixes it, kept as two commits rather than squashed in place.** The gap is worth the record: the branch-walk-only reading passed all seven controls and every pin in the suite, and was wrong on the case the card cares most about. Leg C of the ablation below is the pin that now holds it.
- One pre-existing assertion moved rather than widened: the born-false hermeticity case counted `PASS` lines across the WHOLE output. A third control suite prints its own, so that count is now scoped to the born-false section.
- noted, not filed: `--audit` and `--census` are two population readings in one script with no shared frame; a future round that adds a fourth reading will want one.

## Verification

| gate | exit |
|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run` over all ten suites that read `changeset-presence.yml` | 0 — 455 passed (10 files), including `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`, which is what says no command-parity doc edit is owed |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | 0 |
| `pnpm lint:root` (the wired task that reaches `scripts/`; `turbo run lint` depends on it) | 0 — 32 warnings, 0 errors, none in the three changed files |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 — 7,913 tracked text files scanned |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:test-path-roots` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:shell-escape-residue` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 — no changeset owed; no published source or contract moved |
| `pnpm check:required-check-set` · `pnpm check:merge-queue-head` · `pnpm check:governed-queue-guard` | 0 · 0 · 0 — the three self-tests that read workflow wiring; the last reports 185 cases pass |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (both rounds' paths) | 0 — NOT GOVERNED; `.github/workflows/**` is not one of the five ruled surfaces |

**Ablation — the split's pins actually redden, three legs.** Each leg runs from a committed tree, mutates one deciding line, proves the mutation reached disk by blob hash AND by occurrence counts (deciding line 1 → 0, injected marker 0 → 1), re-runs the suite, then restores with `git checkout HEAD --` and re-verifies by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| leg | from | mutation | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | `2dd38efbb` | `dateClaim` collapsed to `'born'` (blob `5b05a3c6` → `deaf6adb`) | **`WENT FALSE` pin fails** — 1 failed / 106 passed |
| B | `2dd38efbb` | `dateClaim` collapsed to `'went'` (blob `5b05a3c6` → `9b1ad4d2`) | **`BORN FALSE` pin fails** — 1 failed / 106 passed |
| C | `74d723cb3` | base-first dating removed (blob `29919d26` → `2ac4bd83`) | **the pre-existing-claim pin fails** — 1 failed / 108 passed |
| D | `6ca8d4259` | the `selfContradiction` term dropped from the workflow's comment gate (blob `cb79f55d` → `6d2f14ae`) | **both new delivery pins fail** — 2 failed / 109 passed, while the born-false term's own pin stays GREEN |

⭐ Leg D is the one worth reading: the ablated sum is still valid JavaScript and still counts two of the three readings, so it looks healthy — and that is exactly the shape a whole-sum pin blesses. The born-false pin staying green through it is what shows the new pin is specific rather than a blanket string match. Legs A–C redden exactly one assertion each and move nothing else, so the distinction is pinned by the verdict itself and ⛔ not by a count that happens to move. The verdicts are read off the finding lines rather than searched for in the section, because the section's closing prose explains what a WENT FALSE verdict is and is not — a substring search there would have reported a verdict never reached, and it did on the first run.

Session reference, as prose because a footer does not survive a body edit here: `session_015h79niBMyoB1xcaQje3uiz`.
